title: Dorothy and the Wizard of Oz.
lines: In the flat land of Kansas lives a girl.
She lives on a farm with Aunt Em and Uncle Henry.
And with her little dog Toto.
The wind spins round and round.
But Dorothy is still in the house with Toto.
The storm lifts the whole house up!
It spins and floats through the air.
A beautiful land full of colours.
Little people come up to her.
She floats in a pink bubble.
She gives Dorothy sparkly red shoes.
I want to go home, says Dorothy.
Glinda says: Go to the great Wizard of Oz.
He lives in the Emerald City.
Dorothy and Toto walk along the yellow road.
On the way they meet a scarecrow.
I really want a brain, he says.
Then they meet a man made of tin.
Squeak, squeak, now he can move again.
I really want a heart, he says.
Then a lion jumps out of the forest.
But when Toto barks, the lion starts to cry.
I'm so scared, says the lion.
They go to the wizard together.
On the way a wicked green witch tries to stop them.
But her friends come to rescue her.
The scarecrow comes up with a plan.
The tin man cries when he sees Dorothy.
And the lion is very brave.
Dorothy accidentally throws a bucket of water over the witch.
But the wizard is just an ordinary man behind a curtain.
He gives the scarecrow a diploma.
You were already clever, he says.
You came up with a plan.
He gives the tin man a little heart.
He gives the lion a medal.
Glinda says: You had the power to go home all along.
She wakes up in her own bed.
Aunt Em and Uncle Henry are there.
